# Offline environment sources

These assets are original Poly Haven downloads licensed CC0-1.0. The manifest pins URLs, byte lengths and SHA-256 checksums. `Tools/fetch-environment-assets.py` can recover them; the game never downloads assets at runtime.

| Source | Use |
|---|---|
| [Rock Moss Set 02](https://polyhaven.com/a/rock_moss_set_02) | Existing scanned rocks |
| [Shrub Sorrel 01](https://polyhaven.com/a/shrub_sorrel_01) | Existing ground vegetation |
| [Mountainside](https://polyhaven.com/a/mountainside) | Slate Rim cliff faces |
| [Boulder 01](https://polyhaven.com/a/boulder_01) | Quarry boulders and optional rough wheel lines |
| [Grass Medium 01](https://polyhaven.com/a/grass_medium_01) | Nine small/tall blade variants on trail shoulders |
| [Dry Ground Rocks](https://polyhaven.com/a/dry_ground_rocks) | Compacted earth; 2K photographic diffuse, normal and roughness |
| [Rocks Ground 05](https://polyhaven.com/a/rocks_ground_05) | Rocky transitions; 2K photographic diffuse, normal and roughness |
| [Kloofendal partly cloudy pure sky](https://polyhaven.com/a/kloofendal_48d_partly_cloudy_puresky) | Existing photographic sky |

See [Poly Haven's license](https://polyhaven.com/license). Powered by Poly Haven asset data during preparation; API use follows [its public API terms](https://github.com/Poly-Haven/Public-API/blob/master/ToS.md). The separately acquired African Slate Quarry Fab files stay in Epic's cache and are not vendored here.
